name: smwmusic-crash-team-racing-map-all-variations
title: Crash Team Racing - Map (All Variations)
description:
The five variations of the map theme from Crash Team Racing, which all share the same drums and bass but have distinct arrangements to match each setting.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 = N. Sanity Beach (tropical arrangement)
1 = Gemstone Valley (jazzy arrangement)
2 = Lost Ruins (tribal arrangement)
3 = Glacier Park (snowy arrangement)
4 = Citadel City (orchestral arrangement)
